summary.text: Brad Magg is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Matt Oleson and no incumbent is running.

paragraphs.text: Magg advanced from the Democratic primary for District 38 on June 2, 2026.
Magg was also the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2024, when he lost the general election to incumbent Republican Jon Dunwell, 55.7 percent to 44.2 percent.
Ballotpedia lists the Iowa Federation of Labor, AFL-CIO among his endorsements in the 2026 race.
